items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I contacted Jeff. We sent him a tape.

ctx.x: So I contacted Jeff. We sent him a tape. The music started to come to me a week before the festival. This was in August of 2001. I looked at this, and the very first thing I saw was a Bill Smith arrangement of What is This Thing Called Love? in E-major. Bill is a very creative person, but he’s also extremely practical and lazy when it comes to solos. He’s not going to write a solo for himself that he’s going to have to play in F-sharp. So I called him up. I said, “Bill, what did you write This Thing Called Love??…
So that’s the only music we have.
